description.value: Crystal's View Bed & Breakfast is a boutique B&B in North Vancouver founded in 1998, offering ocean-view suites (Queen, Deluxe, and Luxury tiers) described as having a European flair. It is centrally located on a quiet residential crescent minutes from Grouse Mountain, Capilano Suspension Bridge, Lonsdale Quay, and Lynn Canyon. A member of the BC Innkeepers Guild and Canada Select, it holds a 4.9-star rating from over 631 verified customer reviews.
